Market data

Enough market exists. The hard part is choosing a tiny painful workflow.

These numbers are for possibility planning. The safest strategy is still to validate one area by selling to 10 paying businesses before building deeply.

11.87Meconomic units

Bangladesh Economic Census 2024 reporting puts the country near 11.87 million economic units. The opportunity is huge, but most users need simple tools.

41%+retail and repair share

Wholesale, retail, and motor-vehicle repair are the largest block of economic units. Stock, dues, POS, and repair workflows are practical.

436Kfood-service outlets

BBS hotel-restaurant survey reporting counted 436,274 hotels, restaurants, and tea stalls. Table, kitchen, and cash tools have a real base.

9.5K+mapped salons

Public map datasets list about 9,570 hair salons. Informal roadside salons are likely undercounted, so the practical base is bigger.

98.9Kprivate education units

BBS private education reporting shows 98,980 private educational institutions. Fee collection, attendance, and parent reminders are recurring pain.

6,587registered coaching centers

Registered coaching centers alone are in the thousands, with many more informal centers. Monthly fees make this a recurring SaaS fit.

15K+licensed private health facilities

DGHS reporting in 2024 referenced 15,233 licensed private hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, and blood banks. Serial and reporting tools fit.

16.5Mfarmers

Agriculture advisory work cites 16.5 million farmers in Bangladesh, with 85 percent smallholders. Voice-first rural tools can matter.

2.45M+fish farmers

Fisheries statistics point to millions of fish farmers and fishers. Feed, pond, harvest, and buyer records are practical software problems.

186Mmobile connections

BTRC March 2026 reporting puts mobile subscriptions above 186 million. Any Bangladesh product must be mobile-first.

Opportunity cards

Each card has pricing and a calculator. Click any card for the full page.

The default calculator uses 1,000 businesses because it makes the model clear. Change setup and monthly price to test your own package.

Removed from focus

These are intentionally not the plan.

The Bangladesh local market rewards boring, daily-use, cash-visible software. Generic online-store ideas are much harder to sell to the users you want.

Generic online-store setup
Template website resale
Dropshipping courses
Crypto, betting, gambling, lottery, or interest-based finance tools
Broad ERP for everyone
Fake AI certificate course with no practical workplace result
Any product that does not solve a daily queue, dues, booking, stock, fee, training, report, or owner-control problem
